sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: This is not a day when you should be fooling around with your health. Do not take your health and fitness for granted, warns Ganesha You will be feeling lazy and listless all day long. Chances are that you could fall ill on account of carelessness. Both physical exertion as well as mental stress should b meticulously avoided. From sunset onwards you can rest easy. The period of care and caution will have passed.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: With today's energy, you might want to let your imagination run free for a while, Taurus. This can add a real boost, as it will connect you with your inner self. Let your imagination be your ticket to your creative and artistic abilities. Problem-solving skills can also be accented or realized when the mind has time to roam.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Go with the flow while the Capricorn Moon aligns with Mercury and Venus, dearest Taurus. Inspiring, optimistic energy surrounds you, but a desire to fully experience life could trigger control issues. Lean into messy or chaotic moments, recognizing that beauty and magic are often found when plans go awry. Try not to overexert yourself when Mars connects with the nodes of fate. If you've been running on fumes recently, now is a good time to rest up at home and establish better structures to avoid future burnout. Spiritual epiphanies trickle through when you embrace quiet, as Luna aspects Chiron this evening.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: You misunderstand with a friend may invite some unpleasant reaction-get a balanced view before passing any judgement. Today, with the help of a close friend, some businessmen are likely to gain monetary benefits. This money can overcome many of your troubles. A day when work pressure seems to be low and you will enjoy time with family members. Today, you can come back from office and get indulged in some of your favourite hobbies. This will calm you down. You might get an amazing surprise for your marital pleasures. You need to find a reliable solution to your life problems by yourself, as others can only provide you with advice and suggestions.

readings.text: Ganesha feels that it’s going to be very stressful day for you. Health wise, because this is not a good day, you will not be able to complete tasks on hand. You should not waste your time in useless things and should set your priority.

Take a look at what matters most to you in the world. Somewhere on your list is probably a sense of well-being for all, and a safe community for our children to grow up in. One of the ways you can balance your own needs and the needs of the community is through participation in organic farming. Consider getting knowledgeable about the issues surrounding organic farming. Being aware of what you can do will add to your sense of well-being. Buying organic is a political statement as well as a nutritional one!
